note: Acquire is broader than buy; buy specifies purchase-by-payment, lost when collapsed.
Sold-to specifies a purchase transaction; generic acquire doesn't; register also differs.
Call off = phrasal, more informal/spoken register than cancel; truth conditions identical.
Periphrastic 'causes destruction of' adds indirection/mediated-causation nuance vs direct 'destroys'.
Light-verb 'make a decision' vs 'decide': same truth, more formal/bureaucratic register.
Mend vs fix: same truth, but mend has dialectal/literary register for repairs.
Learn/teach are converses; perspective and factivity (teach≠successful-learn) nuance would be lost.
